items.title: Percy Humphrey Band: Percy Humphrey, Jim Robinson, Ernest Roubleau, Josiah Frazier Interview, 1972-02-29
items.q: The interviewer mentions 'beat Buck one another' and the interviewee later refers to 'the buck probably used to pay us more than officers', indicating 'Buck' refers to a military rank (Buck Private) rather than a specific individual person.

ctx.x: And beautiful camps too. And the band used to beat Buck one another. Oh yeah. Just like, I'm playing for you over here, my band, another band over there, we're walking in the next one, he playing trumpet, we're going to beat Buck one another and stand to the next one. Oh man, what fun man. Yeah. Boy, it's not no fun that could just be years ago. The junctures ain't got sense enough to take, to finish what we come through. That's true.
Tell them about the bankers, we call them bunkers them days.
